propositions: Historical whole-file mutation ceilings in signing.py (491 mutants) are stale; pinned mutmut 3.7.0 identifies 814 mutants including both equivalent survivors and real contract gaps
Enforcing old ceilings blocks unrelated work while accepting all survivors would normalize defects; a phased rollout with advisory/ratchet/strict modes and per-shard fingerprinting is needed

Shard selection must map changed source/test/support and infrastructure inputs to the expected set, track renames/deletions, report unmapped tests, and emit explicit JSON for targeted or all-shard runs

Advisory mode gathers evidence nonblocking survivors/no-tests/timeouts; ratchet preserves unchanged legacy outcomes and blocks killed regressions; strict requires all mutants killed or individually fingerprinted

Fresh isolated base/head archives without persisted mutation verdict cache, pinned mutmut 3.7.0 with --max-children 1, timeout_constant=1.0 and timeout_multiplier=15.0, and 30-minute per-shard job limit must be enforced
Real compact-policy smoke run on fresh base/head and documentation contract test asserting live manifest policy, promotion process, and absence of stale score tables must pass
